title: fix(service-analytics)!: the delegated fallback face refuses a date bucket over a formula or non-date field, as the engine face does (#29364)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XpkaL2vbksEkNq2jVX5pqa)_

Fixes #29364

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — a cube query or `/analytics/sql` dry run that `FallbackDelegateStrategy` hands to the host's fallback analytics service is refused `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 at `groupBy.N.dateGranularity` when it buckets a `formula` field or a field declared anything but a date or a datetime, with the engine face's refusal field for field, before the fallback service is called. Measured: on `origin/main` `aca58cdb` the fallback face answered 200 with one `null` group (formula, 3 of 3 rows) and a `null` group beside a parsed text value (text); on this head both are refused on the query and the dry run. Only a host composing the fallback face sees it; no shipped composition reaches that face. Nothing is widened: no export, public member, answer member, error code or status is added.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` or `content/docs` says the analytics fallback service can date-bucket a formula or a text field; the fallback face is not documented as an authoring surface.

Card thread: `session_01ADHkmNhTaQLPMwKLDKtX46`. Seat ruling: option A, record 6581612223 (on the dev's measurement and options, os-dev-report 6581581002).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：分析服务的「后备委托」出口（`FallbackDelegateStrategy`，把查询转交给宿主注册的另一个分析服务，例如内存驱动的 `MemoryAnalyticsService`）现在也先过同一道日期分桶门：按日期粒度对公式字段或非日期字段分桶，查询和 `/analytics/sql` 预演都给出与引擎出口逐字段相同的拒绝（`INVALID_FIELD` / 400，位置 `groupBy.N.dateGranularity`），不再把全部行装进一个空（null）分组答 200。
- **为什么改**：卡 #29364（p3），来自 #29167 合约评审的发现。实测：默认组装下这个出口走不到（自动挂载的插件总把分桶查询交给引擎，引擎早已拒绝）；但公开 API 能走到（`new AnalyticsService({ fallbackService })`，或插件配 `objectqlAggregate: false`），席位裁定 A：复用现成的那道门，不加第三份文字、不碰 spec。
- **风险与回滚**：收窄（标题带 `!`），只影响自行组装后备出口的宿主；日期、日期时间分桶照常委托（已钉住）；宿主没给字段类型时不判，与草稿预览、预演一致。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：① `packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts` 里新的 `assertDelegatedDateBucketsTemporal` 及 `FallbackDelegateStrategy` 两处调用；② 新测试 `src/__tests__/fallback-delegate-date-bucket-type.test.ts`（与真实 ObjectQL + SQLite 引擎出口逐字段比对）；③ changeset。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/fallback-delegate-date-bucket-type.test.ts`，预期 1 个文件 9 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位跑合约评审并落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/service-analytics`, `analytics-service.ts`.** `FallbackDelegateStrategy.execute` and `.generateSql` call a new module-local `assertDelegatedDateBucketsTemporal(query, ctx)` before handing the query to `ctx.fallbackService`. It makes the one call to the service's existing door, `assertDatasetDateBucketsTemporal` (`dataset-date-bucket-door.ts`), with the keys the ObjectQL strategy's direct path would build (`aggregateGroupKeys`, so positions are the engine's), the cube's object (`aggregateObjectOf`) and the context's `declaredFieldType` (the host's `sourceFieldMeta`; `AnalyticsServicePlugin` answers it from the data engine). No third copy of the sentence, no new error code, no spec edit.
- **`dataset-date-bucket-door.ts`.** Doc comment only: names the fallback face as the third face that hands no engine the keys.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/29364-fallback-date-bucket-refused-alike.md`: patch, BREAKING banner, one ADR-0087 marker (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`), and it says only a host composing the fallback face sees the change.

## Why

#29167 (PR #29347) made the engine door, the draft preview and the dry run refuse a date bucket over a virtual or non-date field alike. The delegated fallback service folds a bucket itself and reads no field type, so it stayed the one face answering 200 with a `null` group. Step 0 measured reachability before any code (os-dev-report 6581581002):

| composition | formula month bucket | text month bucket | datetime (control) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `new AnalyticsService({ fallbackService: MemoryAnalyticsService })`, with or without `sourceFieldMeta` | 200, `[{calc: null, count: 3}]` | 200, `[{region: null, count: 2}, {region: '2026-03', count: 1}]` | 200, right buckets |
| `AnalyticsServicePlugin` + pre-registered `MemoryAnalyticsService`, no data engine | 503 at the exposure door | 503 | 503 |
| same + data engine, default capabilities | engine (ObjectQLStrategy) | engine | engine |
| same + `queryCapabilities` with `objectqlAggregate: false` | 200, one `null` group | 200, as row 1 | 200, right buckets |

No shipped composition reaches the face; the public construction paths do, and the seat ruled the fix (A) on that.

## Tests

New file `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/fallback-delegate-date-bucket-type.test.ts`, 9 cases. The engine face is the default composition on real ObjectQL + SqlDriver (better-sqlite3); the fallback faces are both public construction paths with a recording delegate:

- On `new AnalyticsService({ fallbackService })` and on `AnalyticsServicePlugin` with `objectqlAggregate: false`: a formula by month, a text column by month, and a formula after a datetime bucket (`groupBy.1`) are each refused on the query AND the dry run with exactly the engine face's refusal (message, code, status, httpStatus, object, param, path, field, fields), and the delegate's `query` / `generateSql` are never called.
- Control on both faces: a datetime month bucket is delegated (rows passed through, dry run returns the delegate's statement).
- A host with no `sourceFieldMeta` is not judged (delegated), as on the preview and the dry run.

No existing test was edited (no forced test edits).

Ablation (the door taken out, measured, restored; `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which proves the mutation on disk and the restore by blob and `git diff HEAD`). The suite imports `src` relatively, so no `dist` leg applies.

<details><summary>Ablation readings</summary>

- Leg 1, whole door (helper returns before judging), head `1074fbba`: `Tests  6 failed | 3 passed (9)`, first failure `Error: fallback query: expected a refusal, but it resolved`; the three still green are the two controls and the no-types case. Restored: `ok restored: blob == HEAD (362478fe16f5) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
- Leg 2, dry-run call only (`generateSql`), head `cf460c16` (same runtime code; `1074fbba` changed only a type cast): `Tests  6 failed | 3 passed (9)`, failure `Error: fallback sql: expected a refusal, but it resolved`. Restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The door judges only when the host gives field types (`sourceFieldMeta`), the same stand-down the preview and the dry run have; the plugin always wires it from the data engine. A host constructing `AnalyticsService` without it keeps today's delegated answer (pinned).
- Only the date-bucket door is put in front of the delegate, as the ruling orders. The column-asked-twice door (`assertDatasetGroupColumnsDistinct`) the preview also runs is not added here.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 62 commands, every one run, `--ran` reconciliation `62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. Three first answered exit 3 (prerequisite, not a verdict) and were re-run green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` after fetching its pinned fixture commit, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'` (78/78), and `check:type-check-debt`, whose lock call waited behind this card's own dogfood run.

Neither reads analytics. Base leg: with `packages/services/service-analytics/src` restored to `aca58cdb` and its dist rebuilt (the door absent from dist, grep count 0), the same two files answer the same `4 failed | 8 passed (12)`, so they are red on base and not caused by this diff. Both files were re-pointed on `main` after the base by `6af3d2957` (#29451, "re-point the runAs and anonymous-guest flow pins to flow start admission's record rule"). The tree was restored (`git diff HEAD` empty) and the head dist rebuilt (door present, count 3).
